subject: [PATCH v9 01/32] mm: rename pmd_to_softleaf_folio() to pmd_softleaf_to_folio()

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch renames the function pmd_to_softleaf_folio() to pmd_softleaf_to_folio() in the Linux kernel's memory management (mm) module. The original name was misleading as it suggested conversion of a PMD into a folio, whereas the function actually decodes a softleaf entry stored in the PMD and returns the referenced folio. No functional changes are intended by this rename.
